reviews.text: We’d give 10 stars if we could! We interviewed lots of pool builders and trusted our gut, and went with BlueFin- we have been SO happy and are getting a top notch pool! Love the ideas Glen presents and he is always flexible and communicative. Unlike other pool builders that just show up when it’s time to be paid, and let the subs do all the work- we see our PB all the time on the job site. What more could you want?! 110% happy with Bluefin and the progress we’ve made so far on our pool build!
reviews.author: Shannon Showalter

reviews.text: Blue Fin Pools has been a great help with many of our projects. Being able to collaborate with them and utilize their talents has been a huge relief. Glenn is super laid back and prompt with communicating. Their team is clean and courteous while on our job sites. We highly recommend Blue Fin Pools!
reviews.author: Element Pools & Spas

reviews.text: BlueFin went out of their way to make sure my pool redo was the highest quality.  It looks awesome!
reviews.author: Dan Shinedling, Jr.

reviews.text: Bluefin Pools built me an outstanding pool and spa. I received excellent service. In fact, my pool was built ahead of schedule. Glenn Wallwork professionally guided us through the design, building and permitting process. He was responsive to any questions and his supervision of our project led to an awesome pool!
reviews.author: Mark Miller

reviews.text: Glenn was very personable and knowledgeable.  BlueFin did an excellent job with all of our pool update needs. We love how our pool turned out!
reviews.author: Riley St. Germain

reviews.text: Our grandchildren are coming in to town.  We wanted to replaster our pool before they arrive.  Glenn and his team got it done!!  I am from Hawaii and wanted turtles added to my beach.  I wanted 5, to represent my 5 children.  We were short by 2 turtles.  Glenn’s staff hunted around and found the  needed turtles!!!  They placed them exactly where I wanted them.  This pool team are caring and went the extra mile to meet my desire.
reviews.author: Cynthia Riggs

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with BlueFin Pools Inc. for a pool installation, and I couldn't be more thrilled with the results. From the initial consultation to the final touches, the team demonstrated exceptional professionalism and expertise.

The design process was smooth, with clear communication and a genuine understanding of my vision. The construction was timely, with attention to detail and high-quality craftsmanship. The team was courteous, respectful, and left the site clean and tidy after each day's work.

The end result is a beautiful, functional pool that exceeded my expectations. The water features and lighting are stunning, and the overall experience was seamless and stress-free. I highly recommend BlueFin Pools Inc. to anyone looking for top-notch pool services.
reviews.author: Nate Doria

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience with Bluefin Pools! From start to finish, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and dedicated to bringing my pool vision to life.

The design process was collaborative and fun, and they took the time to understand my needs and preferences. The construction crew was efficient and meticulous, ensuring every detail was perfect. They kept me informed throughout the entire process and were always available to answer any questions I had.

The end result is a stunning pool that has exceeded my expectations. It's the perfect place to relax and entertain, and I couldn't be happier with my decision to choose Bluefin Pools. I highly recommend them to anyone looking to create their dream backyard oasis!
reviews.author: Shaun Nelson
